WiWU Bloom 600 — Elevate Your Drive with Aromatherapy and Ambiance

Transform your car into a sanctuary of scent and light with the WiWU Bloom 600. This advanced air diffuser features a captivating galaxy projection, premium imported essential oils, and intelligent scent dispersion for a truly immersive driving experience. Enjoy weeks of refreshing fragrance with its large capacity and smart auto start/stop functionality.
Create a dreamlike, luxurious atmosphere in your car with a captivating starry sky projection.
Experience instant, comfortable, and natural fragrance that fills your car space with ultra-fine mist.
The smart chip synchronizes with your car's ignition, automatically starting the diffuser when you drive and stopping when you turn off the engine.
Customize your driving ambiance with three scent modes: Strong, Light, or Continuous diffusion.
